description: This header file defines the interface for handling output files in the sparse format, including functions for opening, writing chunks, and closing output files.

methods.name: output_file_open_fd
methods.description: Opens an output file with specified parameters including file descriptor, block size, length, and options for compression and sparse format.

methods.name: output_file_open_callback
methods.description: Opens an output file using a callback function for writing data with specified parameters.

methods.name: write_data_chunk
methods.description: Writes a data chunk to the output file.

methods.name: write_fill_chunk
methods.description: Writes a fill chunk with a specified value and length.

methods.name: write_file_chunk
methods.description: Writes a chunk based on external file data with offset and length.

methods.name: write_fd_chunk
methods.description: Writes a chunk from an external file descriptor with specified offset and length.

methods.name: write_skip_chunk
methods.description: Writes a skip chunk of specified length.

methods.name: output_file_close
methods.description: Closes an open output file and releases resources.

methods.name: read_all
methods.description: Reads all data from a specified file descriptor into a buffer.
